biggest_catch: It only finds money that's actually sitting in a state unclaimed-property fund in your name — most people find nothing, and the state (not the site) handles the claim and the wait.
catches: Only finds money if unclaimed property exists in your name — most searches return no match.

steps: Go to https://missingmoney.com/ in your browser.
Type your last name (or business name) and first name into the search boxes and tap Search.
Repeat the search for every state you have lived or worked in; also try previous names and common misspellings (the site explicitly recommends this).
Open any match and check the details (old address, holder name) to confirm the property is really yours.
Tap through to initiate the claim — the site redirects you to the official state treasury/controller website holding the funds.
Submit the state's claim form with your photo ID and proof of address directly to the state.
Wait for the state to verify and pay you; check back often since new properties are added daily.
